description: The ratio column divides each kept telescope's average modulation index by the overall average, which is the mean of the per-telescope averages across all telescopes.

b.request: For each `telescref` in `signals` with at least one non-null `modindex`, calculate its average `modindex`; compute the overall average as the mean of those per-telescope averages; keep telescopes above that overall average; and return the 10 highest by per-telescope average divided by the overall average, showing `telescref`, its unrounded average, its unrounded excess over the overall average, and its unrounded ratio
b.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg FROM telescope_averages) SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_modindex, t.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg AS excess, t.avg_modindex / o.overall_avg AS ratio FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10

c.request: For each telescope (`telescref`) in the signals table, compute its average modulation index (`modindex`), ignoring missing values. Then list the telescopes whose average is above the overall average, taking the overall average as the mean of the per-telescope averages. For each one, show the telescope reference, its average modulation index, how much it exceeds the overall average, and its average as a ratio to the group average. Return the top 10 by that ratio, highest first, without rounding. The ratio column divides each kept telescope's average modulation index by the overall average, which is the mean of the per-telescope averages across all telescopes.
c.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS group_average FROM telescope_averages) SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_modindex, t.avg_modindex - o.group_average AS amount_above_average, t.avg_modindex / o.group_average AS average_ratio FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE t.avg_modindex > o.group_average ORDER BY average_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

a.request: For each telescope (`telescref`) in the signals table, compute its average modulation index (`modindex`), ignoring missing values. Take the overall average to be the mean of these per-telescope averages, so each telescope counts once. Keep only the telescopes whose average is above that overall average. For each one, show the telescope reference, its average modulation index, how far it is above the overall average (its average minus the overall average), and its average divided by the overall average. Sort by that ratio from highest to lowest and return the top 10, without rounding.
a.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg FROM telescope_averages) SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_modindex, t.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, t.avg_modindex / o.overall_avg AS ratio FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE t.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

d.request: For each telescope (`telescref`) in the `signals` table, calculate its average modulation index (`modindex`), ignoring missing values. Calculate the overall average as the mean of those per-telescope averages across all telescopes. Return the 10 telescopes whose averages exceed the overall average, ordered by the ratio of each telescope’s average to the overall average, highest first. Include the telescope reference, its average modulation index, the amount it exceeds the overall average, and that ratio, without rounding.
d.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg FROM telescope_averages) SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_modindex, t.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg AS amount_above_overall, t.avg_modindex / NULLIF(o.overall_avg, 0) AS ratio_to_overall FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE t.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg ORDER BY ratio_to_overall DESC LIMIT 10;
